patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed background sections (white, light beige, vibrant green) create clear visual breaks and hierarchy across the page.
Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings are used for main section titles, often with a single key word highlighted or on its own line for emphasis.
A high-contrast palette of black, white, and a distinctive vibrant lime green is used to delineate sections and draw attention to key information and CTAs.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.
The hero section features abstract background elements that parallax subtly behind the main text as the user scrolls, adding depth.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains visible throughout the scroll, ensuring constant access to main links and CTAs.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library, are used to reveal content sections with a staggered fade-in and slight upward translation as they become visible in the viewport.
The hero section utilizes a subtle parallax effect where abstract background graphics move at a slower rate than the foreground text, enhancing visual depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~4x body) are contrasted with smaller, legible body text and very small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., ~4-8px) are applied to buttons, input fields, and some card elements, while most section edges remain sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness, balanced with tighter content grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and energetic use of a vibrant lime green as a primary accent color, which is strategically applied to full-bleed sections and key interactive elements. This, combined with oversized, clean typography and subtle scroll-triggered animations, creates a highly modern and dynamic user experience that feels both professional and visually engaging.
